## Based On YouTube Comments!

Everything in the mod! ![All Of The Items Inside The Mod!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9e246ac03dd82de5fc9353464f908b978fdedb0.png)

***

### Weapons:

*   Bacon (Flings firey bacon pieces that set mobs on fire!)

*   Nuke (A EXTREMELY Explosive Device.)

*   Chipmunk Launcher (Launches Explosive Chipmunks)

*   Snowball Launcher (Launches Snowballs)

*   Summoning Stick (Summons Nukes When Right Clicked On A Block)

*   Subscribe Sword (Obtained with  /subscribe)

*   Cartoon Gun (Has a 1/10 chance of exploding)

*   Scoarching Sword (Sets the player on fire when in inventory)
 
*   Enchantment Sword (Has EVERY Enchantment in the game!)

*   Perspective Bow (Work-in-progress item)
